statements.statement: The verb 'to be' is an irregular verb in English.
statements.statement_uz: 'To be' fe'li ingliz tilida noto'g'ri fe'l hisoblanadi.
statements.explanation: 'To be' has irregular forms: am, is, are, was, were, been.
statements.explanation_uz: 'To be' noto'g'ri shakllarga ega: am, is, are, was, were, been.

statements.statement: In English, adjectives always come after the noun they describe.
statements.statement_uz: Ingliz tilida sifatlar doim ular tavsiflaydigan otdan keyin keladi.
statements.explanation: In English, adjectives typically come BEFORE the noun (e.g., 'beautiful house').
statements.explanation_uz: Ingliz tilida sifatlar odatda otdan OLDIN keladi (masalan, 'beautiful house').

statements.statement: The past tense of 'go' is 'goed'.
statements.statement_uz: 'Go' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'goed'.
statements.explanation: 'Go' is irregular. Its past tense is 'went'.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Go' noto'g'ri fe'l. Uning o'tgan zamon shakli 'went'.

statements.statement: We use 'an' before words that start with a vowel sound.
statements.statement_uz: Unli tovush bilan boshlanadigan so'zlar oldidan 'an' ishlatamiz.
statements.explanation: We use 'an' before vowel sounds: an apple, an hour (silent 'h').
statements.explanation_uz: Unli tovushlar oldidan 'an' ishlatamiz: an apple, an hour (jim 'h').

statements.statement: 'I have been working' is an example of Present Perfect Continuous tense.
statements.statement_uz: 'I have been working' Present Perfect Continuous zamoniga misol.
statements.explanation: This tense uses 'have/has + been + verb-ing' structure.
statements.explanation_uz: Bu zamon 'have/has + been + fe'l-ing' strukturasidan foydalanadi.

statements.statement: The word 'sheep' has a different plural form.
statements.statement_uz: 'Sheep' so'zining boshqa ko'plik shakli bor.
statements.explanation: 'Sheep' is the same in singular and plural: one sheep, two sheep.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Sheep' birlik va ko'plikda bir xil: one sheep, two sheep.

statements.statement: We can say 'He suggested me to go' in correct English.
statements.statement_uz: To'g'ri ingliz tilida 'He suggested me to go' deyish mumkin.
statements.explanation: Correct: 'He suggested that I go' or 'He suggested going'.
statements.explanation_uz: To'g'ri: 'He suggested that I go' yoki 'He suggested going'.

statements.statement: 'Much' is used with countable nouns.
statements.statement_uz: 'Much' sanaladigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
statements.explanation: 'Much' is for uncountable nouns. 'Many' is for countable nouns.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Much' sanalmaydigan otlar uchun. 'Many' sanaladigan otlar uchun.

statements.statement: The third conditional talks about unreal past situations.
statements.statement_uz: Uchinchi shart gap o'tmishdagi haqiqiy bo'lmagan vaziyatlar haqida gapiradi.
statements.explanation: Third conditional: 'If I had known, I would have come.'
statements.explanation_uz: Uchinchi shart: 'If I had known, I would have come.'

statements.statement: 'Used to' and 'would' can always be used interchangeably for past habits.
statements.statement_uz: 'Used to' va 'would' o'tmishdagi odatlar uchun doim almashtirilishi mumkin.
statements.explanation: 'Would' cannot be used for past states, only actions. 'I used to live there' (not 'I would live there').
statements.explanation_uz: 'Would' faqat harakatlar uchun, holatlar uchun emas. 'I used to live there' (not 'I would live there').

statements.statement: Double negatives are grammatically correct in standard English.
statements.statement_uz: Ikki inkor standart ingliz tilida grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.
statements.explanation: In standard English, double negatives are incorrect: 'I don't have nothing' should be 'I don't have anything'.
statements.explanation_uz: Standart ingliz tilida ikki inkor noto'g'ri: 'I don't have nothing' emas, 'I don't have anything'.

statements.statement: The passive voice can be formed in all tenses.
statements.statement_uz: Majhul nisbat barcha zamonlarda yasalishi mumkin.
statements.explanation: Passive can be formed in most tenses: 'is done', 'was done', 'will be done', 'has been done', etc.
statements.explanation_uz: Majhul ko'p zamonlarda yasaladi: 'is done', 'was done', 'will be done', 'has been done', va h.k.

statements.statement: 'Who' is always used as a subject pronoun.
statements.statement_uz: 'Who' doim egaga oid olmosh sifatida ishlatiladi.
statements.explanation: 'Who' can be subject or object in modern English, though 'whom' is traditional for objects.
statements.explanation_uz: Zamonaviy ingliz tilida 'who' ega yoki to'ldiruvchi bo'lishi mumkin, garchi 'whom' an'anaviy to'ldiruvchi.

statements.statement: Modal verbs are followed by the base form of the verb.
statements.statement_uz: Modal fe'llardan keyin fe'lning asosiy shakli keladi.
statements.explanation: Modal verbs + base form: 'can go', 'must do', 'should try'.
statements.explanation_uz: Modal fe'llar + asosiy shakl: 'can go', 'must do', 'should try'.

statements.statement: The word 'information' can be made plural by adding 's'.
statements.statement_uz: 'Information' so'zini 's' qo'shib ko'plik qilish mumkin.
statements.explanation: 'Information' is uncountable and has no plural form. Use 'pieces of information'.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Information' sanalmaydigan va ko'plik shakli yo'q. 'Pieces of information' ishlating.

statements.statement: 'Neither...nor' takes a singular verb when both subjects are singular.
statements.statement_uz: 'Neither...nor' ikkala ega birlik bo'lganda birlik fe'l oladi.
statements.explanation: 'Neither John nor Mary was there.' - singular verb with singular subjects.
statements.explanation_uz: 'Neither John nor Mary was there.' - birlik egalar bilan birlik fe'l.

statements.statement: Gerunds always end in '-ing' and function as nouns.
statements.statement_uz: Gerundlar doim '-ing' bilan tugaydi va ot vazifasini bajaradi.
statements.explanation: Gerunds: 'Swimming is fun.' (subject), 'I enjoy reading.' (object).
statements.explanation_uz: Gerundlar: 'Swimming is fun.' (ega), 'I enjoy reading.' (to'ldiruvchi).

statements.statement: 'Less' is used with countable nouns and 'fewer' with uncountable.
statements.statement_uz: 'Less' sanaladigan otlar bilan, 'fewer' sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
statements.explanation: It's the opposite: 'fewer' for countable, 'less' for uncountable.
statements.explanation_uz: Aksincha: 'fewer' sanaladigan uchun, 'less' sanalmaydigan uchun.

statements.statement: The present simple tense can be used to talk about the future.
statements.statement_uz: Oddiy hozirgi zamon kelajak haqida gapirish uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.
statements.explanation: For schedules/timetables: 'The train leaves at 6 PM tomorrow.'
statements.explanation_uz: Jadvallar uchun: 'The train leaves at 6 PM tomorrow.'

statements.statement: 'Had better' is followed by 'to + infinitive'.
statements.statement_uz: 'Had better' dan keyin 'to + infinitiv' keladi.
statements.explanation: 'Had better' is followed by bare infinitive: 'You had better go' (not 'to go').
statements.explanation_uz: 'Had better' dan keyin oddiy infinitiv keladi: 'You had better go' (not 'to go').
